title: Circular No.SMDRP/Policy/Cir-37/2000
text: Home »Legal»Circulars Circular No.SMDRP/Policy/Cir-37/2000 Aug 11, 2000| Circulars SECURITIES AND EXCHANGE BOARD OF INDIA SECONDARY MARKET DEPARTMENT Mittal Court, A Wing, Gr. Floor, 224, Nariman Point, Mumbai 400 021 SMDRP/POLICY/CIR- 37 /2000 August 11, 2000 To, The President/Executive Directors/Managing Directors All the Stock Exchanges Dear Sir/Madam, In terms of our circular SMDRP/POLICY/CIR35/2000 dated August 04, 2000, it was provided that the provisions of this circular shall be applicable to issues for which draft offer documents have been filed with SEBI on or after June 15, 2000. The applicability of the said circular has been modified and the circular shall be applicable to issues for which draft offer documents have been filed with SEBI on or after August 07, 2000. Yours faithfully, P. K. BINDLISH Division Chief Secondary Market, Depository Research & Publications Dept. E-mail : pkb@sebi.gov.in Ph. 2843631 Fax-2845761
